blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C2):** eu consigo ler, ouvir, falar e escrever sobre estética a partir de uma carta a um editor, discordando com polidez e usando marcadores formais.

body: Esta aula treina **escrever frases claras e corretas (IELTS Writing, TOEFL Writing)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

frames.title: Reading · A letter to the editor

blocks.subject: Re: “Beauty Is Not in the Eye of the Beholder”
paras: I write in response to your columnist’s claim that beauty is **entirely subjective**. **With respect**, the argument **conflates** disagreement with relativism. That we **quarrel** over a poem does not show that **no standard** is at stake; **were** that so, critics would have long since fallen silent.

Kant, **to whom** your columnist alludes, held that a judgment of taste **speaks with a universal voice** while **resting on feeling**. One may **demur** from his conclusion; one cannot **dismiss it so lightly**. **I would urge** your writer to **engage with** the strongest version of the view. **Yours faithfully,** Hélène Moreau

items.q: The letter-writer agrees with the columnist.

items.why: Kant, to whom your columnist alludes.

blocks.body: Em cartas formais, a **crítica vai ao argumento**, não à pessoa. Pronomes relativos com preposição (*to whom, of which*) dão precisão. Fecho: *Yours faithfully* (sem nome do destinatário) × *Yours sincerely* (com nome).

items.s: With ___ , the argument conflates two things. (respect)
Kant, ___ whom your columnist alludes, held… (to)
___ that so, critics would have fallen silent. (were)
I would ___ your writer to engage with the view. (urge)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

items.pt: Desde que o ponto sobre Kant permaneça.

items.ans: Will you allow us to shorten it

body: **I write in response to…** — Escrevo em resposta a…
**With respect,…** — Com o devido respeito,…
**Yours faithfully.** — Atenciosamente (sem nome).
**I would urge…** — Eu exortaria…
**Take issue with.** — Discordar de.
**Speak with one voice.** — Falar a uma só voz.
**Beauty is in the eye of the beholder.** — A beleza está nos olhos de quem vê.
**Matter of taste.** — Questão de gosto.
**To each his own.** — Cada um com seu gosto.
**Beg to differ.** — Permito-me discordar.
**Madame Moreau, your letter is rather sharp.** — Madame Moreau, sua carta é bem incisiva.
**Will you allow us to shorten it?** — Permite que a encurtemos?
**Provided the Kant point stays.** — Desde que o ponto sobre Kant permaneça.

blocks.title: Newsroom call
lines: Madame Moreau, your letter is rather sharp.
Madame Moreau, sua carta é bem incisiva.
With respect, it targets the argument, not the author.
Com todo respeito, mira o argumento, não o autor.
Will you allow us to shorten it?
Desde que o ponto sobre Kant permaneça.

items.note: Ritmo e ênfase para nuances: o acento muda o sentido (He said she STOLE it × he said SHE stole it) e as pausas separam ideias técnicas densas.
words: I didn’t SAY he did it.
I didn’t say HE did it.
I didn’t say he DID it.

prompts.model: With respect, I think the argument conflates two issues.
Kant, to whom I am indebted, saw the problem.
I would urge the board to reconsider.

blocks.task: Write a 6-sentence letter to the editor disagreeing politely with an opinion you read, using With respect, a prepositional relative and Were… to….
blocks.model: To the Editor, I write in response to your column on city parks. With respect, the argument ignores the elderly, to whom parks are a lifeline. Were the council to cut maintenance, the damage would be lasting. I would urge your writer to visit one at noon. Yours faithfully, Carlos Lima

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
